## What changes for players

<!-- Mods added/removed/bumped, configs shipped. "Nothing — repo only" is fine. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] `versionNumber` bumped in `thunderstore.toml` (only needed if `thunderstore.toml`, `config/`, `README.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` or `icon.png` changed)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has a `## <version>` section describing the change
- [ ] Join-enforced mods (XPortal, Advanced Portals, Seasonality, …) match the versions the **server** runs, and the server is updated in step
- [ ] README mod table / "Settings this pack sets" updated if mods or shipped configs changed
- [ ] `python3 scripts/check_pack.py deps` passes
